```{r}
library(readr)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
combosDF <- read_rds(here("output", "retired", "02_explore_preprocess", "combosDF.rds"))
doc_set_map <- read_rds(here("output", "retired", "02_explore_preprocess", "doc_set_map.rds"))
doc_set_map <- doc_set_map[levels(combosDF$docID)] # harmonise with combosDF order
```

## Create design matrix

```{r}
combosDF_bydoc <- combosDF |>
    group_split(docID)

combosDF_cartprod <- combosDF |>
    group_by(dc, sfp_1, sfp_2, .drop = FALSE) |>
    count()
```


Calling group_by(docID, dc, sfp_1, sfp_2) is too demanding.

Better option: Create the design matrix on my own, based on the one we saw.

Let's first get the observation and offset vectors:
```{r}
n_obs_train = integer(0)
n_obs_val = integer(0)
doc_lengths_val = integer(0)
doc_lengths_train = integer(0)

for(combosDF_doc in combosDF_bydoc){
    currDocID = combosDF_doc$docID[1]
    combosDF_gp <- combosDF_doc %>% 
        group_by(dc, sfp_1, sfp_2, .drop = FALSE) %>%
        count()
    if(doc_set_map[currDocID] == "train"){
        n_obs_train <- c(n_obs_train, combosDF_gp$n)
        doc_lengths_train <- c(doc_lengths_train, rep(combosDF_doc$doc_length[1], nrow(combosDF_gp)))
    } else {
        n_obs_val <- c(n_obs_val, combosDF_gp$n)
        doc_lengths_val <- c(doc_lengths_val, rep(combosDF_doc$doc_length[1], nrow(combosDF_gp)))
    }
    if(length(n_obs_val) %% 43656 != 0) stop()
}

write_rds(n_obs_train, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "n_obs_train.rds"))
write_rds(doc_lengths_train, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "doc_lengths_train.rds"))
write_rds(n_obs_val, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "n_obs_train.rds"))
write_rds(doc_lengths_val, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "doc_lengths_train.rds"))
```

```{r}
n_obs_matrix_train <- as(Matrix(n_obs_train, nrow = sum(doc_set_map == "train"), byrow = TRUE), "CsparseMatrix")
doc_lengths_matrix_train <- as(Matrix(doc_lengths_train, nrow = sum(doc_set_map == "train"), byrow = TRUE), "CsparseMatrix")
Matrix::writeMM(n_obs_matrix_train, file = here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "n_obs_matrix_train.mtx"))
Matrix::writeMM(doc_lengths_matrix_train, file = here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "doc_lengths_matrix_train.mtx"))

n_obs_matrix_val <- as(Matrix(n_obs_val, nrow = sum(doc_set_map != "train"), byrow = TRUE), "CsparseMatrix")
doc_lengths_matrix_val <- as(Matrix(doc_lengths_val, nrow = sum(doc_set_map != "train"), byrow = TRUE), "CsparseMatrix")
Matrix::writeMM(n_obs_matrix_val, file = here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "n_obs_matrix_val.mtx"))
Matrix::writeMM(doc_lengths_matrix_val, file = here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "doc_lengths_matrix_val.mtx"))
```

The design matrix is just the same thing repeated n times over. So here is it once:

```{r}
X_onedoc <- model.matrix(~ 0 + dc + sfp_1 + sfp_2, combosDF_cartprod,
              contrasts = 
                list(
                    sfp_1 = contrasts(combosDF_cartprod$sfp_1, contrasts=FALSE),
                    sfp_2 = contrasts(combosDF_cartprod$sfp_2, contrasts=FALSE))
                )
X_onedoc <- as(X_onedoc, "dgCMatrix")
write_rds(X_onedoc, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "X_onedoc.rds"))
Matrix::writeMM(X_onedoc, file = here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "X_onedoc.mtx"))
```

And everything else:
```{r}
X <- X_onedoc
for(i in 1:length(levels(combosDF$docID)) - 1){
    # if(i %% 50 == 0) print(glue::glue("{i} / length(levels(combosDF$docID)) - 1"))
    X <- rbind(X, X_onedoc)
    if(nrow(X) %% 43656 != 0) stop()
}
write_rds(X, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "X.rds"))
```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
model_pois <- glmnet(X, n_obs, family = poisson(), offset = log(doc_lengths))

```

## Create design matrix (take 2)
```{r}
combosDF <- combosDF |>
    mutate(bookID = stringr::str_extract(docID, r"(KR\d[a-z]\d{4}(?=_))")) |>
    mutate(bookID = factor(bookID)) |>
    group_by(bookID) |>
    mutate(book_length = sum(doc_length)) |>
    ungroup()
```


```{r}
combosDF_bybook <- combosDF |>
    group_split(bookID)

combosDF_cartprod <- combosDF |>
    group_by(dc, sfp_1, sfp_2, .drop = FALSE) |>
    count()
```


Calling group_by(bookID, dc, sfp_1, sfp_2) is too demanding.

Better option: Create the design matrix on my own, based on the one we saw.

Let's first get the observation and offset vectors:
```{r}
n_obs = integer(0)
book_lengths = integer(0)
for(combosDF_book in combosDF_bybook){
    print(combosDF_book$bookID[1])
    combosDF_gp <- combosDF_book %>% 
        group_by(dc, sfp_1, sfp_2, .drop = FALSE) %>%
        count()
    n_obs <- c(n_obs, combosDF_gp$n)
    book_lengths <- c(book_lengths, rep(combosDF_book$book_length[1], nrow(combosDF_gp)))
    if(length(n_obs) %% 43656 != 0) stop()
}
write_rds(n_obs, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "n_obs.rds"))
write_rds(book_lengths, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "book_lengths.rds"))
```

The design matrix is just the same thing repeated n times over. So here is it once:

```{r}
X_onebook <- model.matrix(~ 0 + dc * sfp_1 * sfp_2, combosDF_cartprod,
              contrasts = 
                list(
                    sfp_1 = contrasts(combosDF_cartprod$sfp_1, contrasts=FALSE),
                    sfp_2 = contrasts(combosDF_cartprod$sfp_2, contrasts=FALSE))
                )
X_onebook <- as(X_onebook, "dgCMatrix")
write_rds(X, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "X_onebook.rds"))

```

And everything else:
```{r}
X <- X_onebook
for(i in 1:(length(levels(combosDF$bookID)) - 1)){
    # if(i %% 50 == 0) print(glue::glue("{i} / length(levels(combosDF$bookID)) - 1"))
    X <- rbind(X, X_onebook)
    if(nrow(X) %% 43656 != 0) stop()
}
write_rds(X, here("output", "retired", "03_negbin_model", "X.rds"))
```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
model_pois <- glmnet(X, n_obs, family = poisson(), offset = log(book_lengths))

```
